source: Selected from a 60-task evaluation pool derived from the upstream Toolathlon Gym 503-task finalpool.

selection.criteria: Gain-first selection using base-model and three SFT baseline outcomes. Nine tasks were solved by at least one SFT baseline and neither base-model run (one solved by all three SFT baselines, four by two, and four by one). Three additional tasks cover arxiv-latex, canvas, and youtube-transcript, completing coverage of all 21 non-infrastructure MCP servers. Inferred subset scores are base 0/12 and SFT 5/12 for each mixed-data, pool-only, and dive-only variant; exclusive-solver counts are 1, 1, and 2 respectively.
selection.evidence: Per-sample base-model and SFT evaluation outcomes used for subset selection.
selection.contamination: All 12 selected task IDs have zero exact matches in the 8000-sample dive-mix8000.jsonl training pool from guoxinzju/vibetrainbench-toolathlon.
selection.order: load-bearing: --limit N takes the first N; the validation split is a prefix. Ordered gain-first (sft=3, sft=2, then sft=1), all-fail fills last, so --limit 9 is exactly the SFT-gain core.
